chunks: 5846 - And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:

“Glad tidings to the one whose life is long and whose deeds are good, so his final return is good, when his Lord is pleased with him. And woe to the one whose life is long and whose deeds are evil, so his final return is evil, when his Lord, Mighty and Majestic, is displeased with him.”

key_terms.رَضِيَ عَنْهُ رَبُّهُ: his Lord is pleased with him
key_terms.سَخِطَ عَلَيْهِ رَبُّهُ: his Lord is displeased with him
key_terms.طُوبَى: glad tidings and blessed good fortune
key_terms.عُمُرُهُ: his lifespan or length of life
key_terms.مُنْقَلَبُهُ: his final outcome, return, or end

ai.seo_question: What does Islam say about living a long life with good or bad deeds?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that the true value of a long life lies in righteous action, not mere longevity. A good end belongs to the one whose deeds are sound and whose Lord is pleased with him, while a bad end belongs to the one whose long life is filled with evil deeds and divine displeasure.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5846 - Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said:

"Glad tidings to the one whose life is long and whose deeds are good, for his outcome will be good as his Lord (azj) is pleased with him. And woe to the one whose life is long and whose deeds are evil, for his outcome will be bad as his Lord (azj), the Mighty and Majestic, is displeased with him."
